title: 2023 Trend Check
notes: Free interactive page, first archived 2022-12-03 (published on or before that date). Lists 15 mega-trends in alphabetical order, numbered 1-15; each has a subtitle, an intro paragraph (quote taken from it), a self-assessment quiz and three opportunities (COMMENCING, ADVANCING, PIONEERING), whose labels are listed in note. A 2023 Trend Check PDF also existed (hubfs/2023-Trend-Check.pdf), not read. The full 2023 Trend Report (Premium) is not captured. target_year 2023 from the title.

entries.label: AGE OF HEALING
entries.quote: This reprioritization means that every brand needs to ideate how to integrate wellness into 2023's products, services, experiences, campaigns and more.
entries.subject: Holistic wellbeing (mental, emotional, spiritual)
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Consumers seek new routes to enlightenment'. Opportunities: commencing: INTERNAL HEALING; advancing: CARE COLLABS; pioneering: INTERVENTION AID.

entries.label: AIDED BY AI
entries.quote: After decades of progress, artificial intelligence and robotics are moving out of the lab and becoming integrated into consumers' day-to-day lives.
entries.subject: AI and robotics in daily life
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Embedding assistive intelligence into consumers' lives'. Opportunities: commencing: INFLATION SUPPORT; advancing: FAIRNESS OPTIMIZERS; pioneering: ARTIFICIAL I. Horizon from the text: 'Think 2023-2030 on this one.'

entries.label: BEHAVI:OUR
entries.quote: Using demographic segmentation to predict consumer behavior is a thing of the past.
entries.subject: Values-based rather than demographic segmentation
entries.note: Subtitle: 'The rise of value-led segmentation'. Opportunities: commencing: ACCESS FOR ALL; advancing: BEYOND THE BINARY; pioneering: DEMOGRAPHIC DISRUPTORS.

entries.label: BRAND BEINGS
entries.quote: In 2023 and beyond, brands are expected to be at the forefront of purposed change.
entries.subject: Brands acting on social and environmental change
entries.note: Subtitle: 'From authenticity to action'. Opportunities: commencing: ROAD MAP TO ROAD TRIP; advancing: PROFIT PROPHETS; pioneering: THE LAW OF THE BRAND.

entries.label: CREATOR INC.
entries.quote: Whether it's through creating content, selling goods and services or renting out excess assets, even more consumers in 2023 will become their own businesses.
entries.subject: Creator economy and consumer entrepreneurship
entries.note: Subtitle: 'The enterprization of consumers'. Opportunities: commencing: IN-HOUSE INVENTORS; advancing: SIDE-HUSTLE HEROES; pioneering: BOTTOM-UP BRANDS.

entries.label: FOR YOU
entries.quote: Relevance-as-a-service is the name of the game.
entries.subject: Personalized curation
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Curation that empowers consumers' uniqueness'. Opportunities: commencing: CHOICE RELIEF; advancing: VALUE VENTURES; pioneering: CURATED IDENTITIES.

entries.label: FREEDONISM
entries.quote: One powerful remedy to combat the feeling of languishing? FUN!
entries.subject: Fun and play as relief from anxiety
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Fun as the ultimate fear antidote'. Opportunities: commencing: INFORMAL INFO; advancing: CARELESS CARE; pioneering: PURPOSE JOLTS.

entries.label: GLASS BOX BRANDS
entries.quote: The connected world has ushered in an era of radical transparency, one where an organization's internal processes are an increasingly important part of its external-facing brand.
entries.subject: Corporate transparency
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Are you part of the ongoing transparency revolution?'. Opportunities: commencing: MISTAKE RE-TAKE; advancing: METRICS OVER MARKETING; pioneering: TANGIBLE VALUES.

entries.label: JOYNING
entries.quote: Therefore, in 2023, consumers will value and show support to brands that help foster connections that are genuine, supportive, and meaningful.
entries.subject: Meaningful social connection
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Finding meaningful connections in a lonely world'. Opportunities: commencing: CONNECTIVITY CULTIVATORS; advancing: CROWD NURTURING; pioneering: FANDOM FORGING.

entries.label: METAPHYSICAL
entries.quote: While yesterday’s web was dominated by websites and the infinite scroll of social media, the next iteration is defined by virtual worlds, metaverses and augmented realities.
entries.subject: Metaverse, web3 and virtual goods
entries.note: Subtitle: 'An evolved internet'. Opportunities: commencing: VIRTUAL EDUCATORS; advancing: META-DEMOCRACY; pioneering: DIRECT-TO-COMMUNITY. Printed 'METAPHYSICAL' here; 'META-PHYSICAL' in the 2022 edition.

entries.label: POWER TO THE PEOPLE
entries.quote: Around the world, people are taking their frustrations to the streets, to chat rooms and their employers, exposing social and ecological injustices while building a new system.
entries.subject: Citizen activism and distrust of institutions
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Citizens taking back control'. Opportunities: commencing: ACTS OF REFLECTION; advancing: CULTURE CATALYSTS; pioneering: FOR & BUY.

entries.label: PRECAREIOUS
entries.quote: Facing a future that's more uncertain than ever before, consumers are looking for brands to help them build resilience.
entries.subject: Insecurity, crisis and resilience
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Adjusting to an uncertain world'. Opportunities: commencing: CRISIS COMPANIONS; advancing: FACT FINDERS; pioneering: RESILIENT FUTURES. Label printed 'PRECAREIOUS' (sic, wordplay on precarious/care).

entries.label: SOLACE AS A SERVICE
entries.quote: But as inflation bumps into the shift towards more conscious consumerism , more consumers will assess the value an item or service delivers both now and in the long term.
entries.subject: Guilt-free convenience
entries.note: Subtitle: 'The emergence of conscious convenience'. Opportunities: commencing: MINDFUL POSSESSIONS; advancing: AUTOMATED WELLNESS; pioneering: NORM-NUDGING.

entries.label: STATE OF PLACE
entries.quote: And while consumers appreciate brands that help them embrace place, moving forward they will have particular affection for the brands that also actively work to make those spaces better in 2023 (read: more sustainable and equitable).
entries.subject: Localism and place-making
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Consumers look to reclaim their locale'. Opportunities: commencing: SHARED SPACES; advancing: REGENERATION NATION; pioneering: LASTING LOCALITY.

entries.label: UNCONSUMED
entries.quote: This group will embrace more mindful modes of consumption (think: refrain, reduce, regenerate) that not just tackle the effects of consumption (if not indulgence) but actually cut out entire parts of their usual consumption patterns.
entries.subject: Reduced consumption
entries.note: Subtitle: 'Consumption is turned on its head'. Opportunities: commencing: (R)E-WASTE; advancing: WASTE AWAY; pioneering: COUNTERFAKE. Intro cites '87% of Business Leaders expect to increase sustainability investment in 2023/24' (third-party survey; not recorded as metric).
